title: The Garfield County Sheriff Office
description: garcosheriff.com The Garfield County Sheriff's Office is the primary law enforcement agency serving Garfield County, Colorado. Its mission is to deliver exceptional service and problem-solving solutions to the community through professional, ethical, and compassionate conduct. The office provides comprehensive public safety services, including patrol, detentions, criminal investigations, and community outreach programs like "Shop with a Cop" and emergency mass notifications
